ctx.x: Coatesville, Pennsylvania, and they moved to Homestead I guess about the turn of the century. In fact -- this is 1980 -- I'll be going back to Homestead at the end of August to participate in the celebration of the 100th anniversary of the settlement of Homestead, Pennsylvania. So I ought to be able to pick up some information then.

Of course Homestead was settled in I guess, 1880, so I was born 31 years after Homestead was settled and of course I suppose you realize that Homestead was the center of the Andrew Carnegie steel mills and it was quite an industrial city at the time.

My grandmother, my father's mother was the first black woman to settle in Homestead and there were ten of her children. My father was the third from the oldest and my mother, there were just the two of them. She had a brother, Paul.
